steps.step: opens the home page on her phone
picks 4 guests in the booking bar and taps Find a table
finds a free time
fills in her details
confirms the booking
cancels the booking
signs in
sees 7 of 8 stamps
orders a Margherita to collect and pays
the kitchen cooks it and he collects it
the eighth stamp turns into a reward
spends the reward on the next order
creates an account
switches to delivery and fills a basket
finds her address by postcode
pays: her first card is declined, the second goes through
signs in on the driver screen
the kitchen cooks it
sees it ready (live) and takes it
drives the route
watches the rider move on her map
hands it over
sees it delivered
signs in and opens the floor
signs in and opens transactions
seats two walk-ins at Table 2
scans the QR code at Table 2 and gives her name
scans the QR code at Table 2 and gives his name
adds Cacio e pepe
adds an Aperol spritz
sees Lena's dish in the table's order, live
sends the whole table's order to the kitchen
is told Theo sent it, without reloading
sees the guests' QR order arrive without reloading
the kitchen serves it; the table shows Eating
settles the bill by card
sees Marco's card payment appear live
opens the overview: takings, two weeks of trade, best sellers
raises the Tiramisu price in the menu editor
sees the new price on her open menu, without reloading
makes an invite link for a new kitchen hand
opens the invite, chooses a password and is signed in
opens the kitchen screen with that account
resets the table
30 guests book Saturday 2026-11-28 at 20:00 for four at the same moment
steps.note: 10 booked, each on a different table (Table 1, Table 9, Table 10, Table 14, Table 8, Table 13, Table 4, Table 2, Table 3, Table 7); 20 were told it had just been taken; 20:00 now shows as full.
